related.title: Segment Routing：SID 清單與路徑約束
related.titleEn: Segment Routing: SID lists and path constraints
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：僅接受每條鏈路remaining≥0；釋放時只回收本LSP資源。 交接時須能核對：交付 reservation-ledger.csv、拒絕理由與釋放後守恆核對。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept only nonnegative remaining capacity on every link and release only this LSP’s resources. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver reservation-ledger.csv, rejection reasons and post-release conservation checks.
related.difference: 在小型圖上逐段展開node SID最短路徑與adjacency SID固定邊，保存結果。
related.differenceEn: Expand node-SID shortest paths and adjacency-SID fixed edges on a small graph.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
RSVP-TE路徑需同時滿足拓撲與資源限制；鏈路速率不是可立即保留頻寬。
教學基準：min(100-30-40,100-55-40) = 5 Mb/s；對照：min(100-30-50,100-55-50) = -5 Mb/s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

Segment Routing以有序segments表達轉送指示；節點SID與鄰接SID約束不同。
教學基準：4*4 = 16 B；對照：6*4 = 24 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
RSVP-TE paths must satisfy topology and resource constraints; line rate is not currently reservable bandwidth.
Teaching baseline: min(100-30-40,100-55-40) = 5 Mb/s; comparison: min(100-30-50,100-55-50) = -5 Mb/s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Segment Routing expresses forwarding through ordered segments; node SIDs and adjacency SIDs impose different constraints.
Teaching baseline: 4*4 = 16 B; comparison: 6*4 = 24 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NSEC3：歷史迭代雜湊的工作量稽核
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：僅接受每條鏈路remaining≥0；釋放時只回收本LSP資源。 交接時須能核對：交付 reservation-ledger.csv、拒絕理由與釋放後守恆核對。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept only nonnegative remaining capacity on every link and release only this LSP’s resources. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver reservation-ledger.csv, rejection reasons and post-release conservation checks.
related.difference: 按名稱記錄初始及額外雜湊呼叫數，把salt輸入與iterations分成不同欄。
related.differenceEn: Count initial and additional calls per name, keeping salt and iterations separate.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

教學基準：min(100-30-40,100-55-40) = 5 Mb/s；對照：min(100-30-50,100-55-50) = -5 Mb/s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

NSEC3 iterations欄位代表初始雜湊之外的額外輪次；本課分析舊紀錄，不建議提高迭代值。
教學基準：1000*(10+1) = 11000 hash calls；對照：1000*(0+1) = 1000 hash calls。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

Teaching baseline: min(100-30-40,100-55-40) = 5 Mb/s; comparison: min(100-30-50,100-55-50) = -5 Mb/s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

NSEC3 iterations count rounds after the initial hash; this course audits historical records and does not recommend higher iterations.
Teaching baseline: 1000*(10+1) = 11000 hash calls; comparison: 1000*(0+1) = 1000 hash calls. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
